name: memplex
description: Multi-agent memory system -- persistent knowledge graph with 3-layer retrieval, compaction, and wiki

interface.shortDescription: Persistent knowledge graph memory with 3-layer retrieval for Claude Code sessions.
interface.longDescription: Memplex captures knowledge from documents, URLs, and conversations, extracts structured memories, and provides fast retrieval across sessions. Features 4 memory types, 5-dim reranking, and automatic compaction.
